account_verification.subject: Verify your account
account_verification.preheader: Confirm your email to finish setting up your Raven account.
account_verification.heading: Please verify your email
account_verification.intro: Thank you for signing up to Raven. To finish your registration, please confirm your email address using the button below.
account_verification.fallback_label: Button not working? Copy and paste this link into your browser:
account_verification.disclaimer: You're receiving this email because someone signed up for Raven with this address. If that wasn't you, you can safely ignore it. The unverified sign-up will be deleted after 7 days.

password_reset.subject: Reset your password
password_reset.preheader: Use this link to reset your Raven password.
password_reset.heading: Reset your password
password_reset.intro: We received a request to reset the password for your Raven account. Use the button below to choose a new one.
password_reset.fallback_label: Button not working? Copy and paste this link into your browser:
password_reset.disclaimer: If you didn't request a password reset, you can safely ignore this email. Your password won't change.
